text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, meaning sex was not a disqualifying factor in the hiring decision. An all-female selection panel hiring a female candidate offers no factual or legal foundation for sex discrimination. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could damage your professional reputation.

The announcement indicates the bank prioritized broad regulatory affairs experience alongside finance expertise for this executive post. Instead of questioning the panel's composition, send a polite, professional follow-up on your feedback request. Frame your inquiry around constructive insights for future senior opportunities rather than disputing the outcome.
